purpose: Calibrate model parameters and test predictions against held-out observed disruption, closure, traffic or recovery outcomes.

mathematical_formulation.calibration: theta_hat = argmin_theta sum_{i in train} w_i ell(y_i, yhat_i(theta))
mathematical_formulation.ranking_agreement: Compare predicted and observed rankings using declared rank and top-k overlap measures

unlock_rule: Disabled until an observed target and leakage-safe validation design are supplied; descriptive fit is not accepted as out-of-sample validation.

primary_sources.citation: Transport World Model computational experiment and validation contract v1.0.0.
primary_sources.relationship: Engineering validation protocol; the selected predictive model must bring its own peer-reviewed basis.

known_limitations: Spatial and temporal leakage can inflate accuracy.
Predictive validation alone does not establish causality.
